intent: Identify and resolve performance issues with frame rate drop during gaming.
detected_fault: 10% drop in frame rate (FPS) while playing games
suggested_solution: Run a stress test to identify thermal or power-related issues
Check for BIOS updates and install the latest version
Verify all drivers are up-to-date, particularly NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti driver
Consider running a system file check (SFC)
